signup.title: Agent signup links
signup.subtitle: The company's open signup links — anyone who opens one lands straight on the signup form, no invite code to type
signup.card_help: Unlike a team invite link, this one belongs to the COMPANY and is tied to no team leader — nobody who signs up through it is counted as anyone’s recruit.
signup.code_help_tail: because the link may already be printed. To get a different code, close this link and create another.
signup.opt_expiry_none: Never expires — right for a link printed on a flyer or a sign
signup.opt_limit_none: No limit on how many people sign up through this link
signup.err_expiry_required: You ticked "expires" — please pick the expiry date
signup.err_limit_required: You ticked "limited" — please enter how many people
signup.revoke_body: Close {url} — anyone who opens it can no longer sign up (the {count} who already did stay exactly as they are). If this link has been printed, the printed copies stop working immediately, and this cannot be undone.
